_doc: 19 Part A — the 30 in-run event cards, transcribed with their titles, bodies, option labels and outcome odds verbatim, and their EFFECTS translated into the closed six-op vocabulary schema/board_events.schema.json defines. ⚠️ The translation is the authored decision, not the numbers: 19 Part A's prose describes movement, battles, gear, perks, stat buffs, tile reveals, consumables and reroll charges, so each outcome Core cannot execute carries one UNSUPPORTED op naming the mechanic and its owning milestone. Two of those groups have since been RESOLVED rather than deferred: the three reroll-charge grants are now FIXED_DIE choices (04 §6), and the three tile-reveal OPTIONS are gone from this document entirely — not deferred, not left paying nothing, DELETED, with no replacement. The board is completely visible at all times (04 §4, 16 D42), so what they offered cannot exist, and a card listing an option that pays nothing asks the player to make a choice that is not one. So EVT_OLD_SOLDIER, EVT_ARCHIVE and EVT_LAST_LAMP each offer TWO options here where 19 Part A's table lists three, and 19 says so on each of their rows. ⚠️ Option order is load-bearing (EVENT_CHOOSE names an option by index) and removing one RENUMBERS those after it — safe here because an index is carried by one transient command and persisted nowhere; only the drawn card's id is on the run. Currency and HP percentages are the only two things the resolver can genuinely execute, plus a curse's authored paired reward (19 Part E) WITHOUT the curse itself, which is M3-11's. 19 Part A's own trailing note flags events 11-30's weights and value scalars as indicative pending the doc-21 economy simulator; they are transcribed as written.
